displayText: Here's one way to remember it. Think of the power, a x plus b, as the playback speed of the curve. a is the speed. Play it twice as fast, and the curve rises twice as fast at every height. Play it backwards, and it falls instead. b just starts the playback at a different point, so it adds no rate factor. And k makes the whole picture bigger, so heights and slopes grow together. In short, copy the exponential, then multiply by k and by a.
